flag_status_rule: Determine each semantic flag separately. A flag is positive once at least one confirmed in-scope issue satisfies its definition, even if another potentially qualifying issue remains pending. A flag is negative only after a complete issue review finds no confirmed or pending issue qualifying for that flag. Otherwise it is indeterminate. A pending issue relevant only to the other flag does not make this flag indeterminate once this flag has been fully assessed.
flag_clarifications: A control EMG route-C statement that all seven displayed max |z| values are below the supplied 3.65 endpoint is a displayed-value comparison and does not itself trigger the normality flag. A question presupposing an unsupported clinical deficit is assessed as an assertion under the existing rubric; the pathology flag for that presupposition requires a confirmed E02 issue, not question syntax alone. Other flag-qualifying assertions remain assessed under their applicable existing error categories. No new mandatory report content, error category or penalty is introduced.
